data.name: Vaibhavraj
data.gender_notes: Vaibhavraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vaibhavraj is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'vaibhav' (radiant, prosperous) and 'raj' (king). In Hindu mythology, Vaibhavraj is believed to represent the divine ruler of prosperity and success. The name Vaibhavraj carries the meaning “Radiant, Prosperous, King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Vaibhavraj usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, prosperous, king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner radiance of an enlightened soul and the spiritual prosperity of a wise and virtuous person.
data.etymology: Vaibhavraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Prosperous, King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vaibhavraj total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

Vaibhavraj is a name that resonates with the belief in a just and flourishing society, where individuals strive for success and abundance.
data.spiritual_significance: Vaibhavraj is a name with deep spiritual significance in Hinduism. It represents the divine ruler of prosperity and success, reminding us of the spiritual connection between material abundance and spiritual growth. Vaibhavraj is a reminder that success and prosperity do not come from material possessions, but from within, from the strength and determination of the individual. Vaibhavraj is a name that inspires us to strive for spiritual growth while recognizing and celebrating the material benefits that come from our efforts.

vedic_reference.note: Vaibhavraj is a modern Sanskrit name derived from Vaibhav (abundance, prosperity) and Raja (king).

historical_references.reference: Vaibhavraj was the name of the powerful Maratha king, Shivaji Maharaj's fourth son. He was given this name to signify his prosperity, power and grandeur.
Vaibhavraj was also a renowned Jain monk and philosopher who flourished in the 12th century CE. He is remembered for his works on Jainism, particularly his commentary on the 'Agam Sutra'.

Overall, Vaibhavraj is a versatile name that resonates with individuals across various industries, interests, and belief systems.
